newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index sinks 4.12 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index sinks 4.12 pct in late trade.

text.p: The peso's fall to its record low and the Dow's steep drop battered Philippine shares in late Monday trade as the main index lost 100.83 points, or 4.12 percent at 2,348.10 points.
"Definitely it's the peso hitting 30 to a dollar that's making the market move this way," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Orion-Squire Capital.
Turnover was moderate at 1.1 billion pesos in late trade. Losers led gainers 134 to 3.

"Some of the fund managers are cutting their losses but there are some who are still holding on, that's why value has not reached two billion pesos," said Carl Valentin, trader at Asia Pacific Capital Equities.
PLDT lost 35 pesos to 840 in late trade leading the active losers while Meralco B was following suit with a loss of nine pesos to 110. Meralco B was the second most actively traded issue.
The main index has shed nearly 350 points since it's 2,694.79 point level, eight days ago, the last time the market's gauge closed in positive territory.
